Sealed candidate marker uses the actual original before/after WORKSPACE pair with retain_last_transition=true; original receiver recovers exact pair, preserves marker-referenced artifact, retains unique original event/current pointer and owner Stop proof.
verified_final_replay: r19 normal passes exact stale-revision final Result replay after Worker cleanup with original Result/ref/SHA/bytes and zero state/journal writes; forged Main facts conflict; completed execution Hook responsibility remains valid.
limits_and_remaining: Mechanical professional answer fixtures and fake launch executable do not establish live model judgment or a live Claude/Agent Team runtime.

This slice is partial S9. Typed non-pass recovery, per-unit actual diff attribution, repeated-command indexed runner, native Main-checkout topology, later typed Changeset/Impact/Targeted/Handoff/fresh S7 and broader global implementation cards remain required.

Accepted typed Result with a still-verified checkpoint refuses a moved Main target before any checkpoint/runtime/result write. An automatic authorized successor verification attempt for this interrupted-before-ACK drift case remains unimplemented; verified checkpoints cannot use the existing unverified-only workspace rework.
The five-package scoped race run is not the complete original Hook-to-Main chain under race. Package compilation with no matching tests is recorded separately in the raw results.
Pending marker tests use exact accepted before/after pairs; where performed, they model sealed commit recovery and do not simulate process hardkill or powerloss.

Concurrent final submissions, stale unaccepted final staging, sibling final refs, Rework lineage and Worker-owned check matrices still need their own exact evidence; do not infer coverage from PlanReport recovery or the Main-only positive chain.

The previous PlanReport -03 package is a distinct frozen artifact and does not attest subsequent RepairResult code. New package evidence, if present, records only local build/disposable install, not real macOS/Windows or live model platform attestation.
